description: Theme-owned editorial route (Weaverse CUSTOM page at that exact path) /field-testing. Values are the ones src/app/field-testing/page.tsx renders today.

data.heading: Test the system, not the claim.
data.lede: Wind, rain, abrasion, repeated packing, and long movement reveal more than an isolated specification ever will.

image.altText: Climber on an open granite face under a wide pale sky

data.heading: From controlled checks to useful failure.
data.steps:
01 | Baseline | Confirm construction, fit, range of movement, and every functional detail before field use.
02 | Exposure | Use the product through realistic weather and terrain in combination with the complete system.
03 | Repetition | Pack, wash, adjust, and wear repeatedly to surface friction, fatigue, and awkward interactions.
04 | Repair review | Evaluate how failure can be diagnosed and repaired before a product earns a permanent place.
